newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee up in spot, down in fwd as RBI buys.
newsitem.headline: India rupee up in spot, down in fwd as RBI buys.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) bought December and January dollars on Tuesday afternoon, leading to a sharp rise in forward premiums, dealers said.
January dollars jumped to 83/86 paise from 78/80 opening following the central bank intervention, dealers said.
Margins rose across maturities on the RBI move, they said.
"But they are the only payers (of premia) in the market," said a dealer.
Earlier on Tuesday, RBI bought spot dollars at 35.74 rupees.
The spot rupee gained to 35.725/735 from 35.73/74 opening.
